process_area.title: Enterprise Account Growth, Contract & Executive Engagement

value_stream.name: Strategic Key Account & Enterprise Customer Management

fields.Participants: Account Manager, Finance (links to VS-17.4), Market Intelligence (links to VS-44/VS-57/VS-33.3), Category (links to VS-01)
fields.Volume: ~700 strategic accounts; focus on top tiers

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Account Manager/Finance estimate the customer's total addressable spend in…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-identify of "Account Manager/Category identify white-space" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track share-growth over time" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-551 (ensure controlled execution — Enterprise Account Growth, Contract & Executive Engagement (PA-107.2).)
- operational: triangulation and customer JBP; operational: pursuit plan and QBR tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Estimation-error risk**: Wrong addressable-spend estimate distorts the growth plan; mitigated by triangulation and customer JBP
- **White-space-inaction risk**: Identified opportunities not pursued; mitigated by pursuit plan and QBR tracking
System Touchpoints: - Finance/revenue analytics (links to VS-17.4); CRM/CDP (links to VS-13.3); market intelligence (links to VS-44/VS-57/VS-33.3); category (links to VS-01)

steps.activity: Account Manager/Finance estimate the customer's total addressable spend in BuildRight's categories (construction/renovation/operations) from project scale (links to VS-11.2/VS-66), industry benchmarks, and market intelligence (links to VS-44/VS-33.3); compute current share-of-wallet from actuals (links to VS-17.4/VS-13.3)

Account Manager/Category identify white-space: categories/products not currently bought, project phases not served, geographies/sites not covered, and competitor-served spend; quantify the opportunity ($, GM$, strategic value) and prioritize

Account Manager integrate the share-of-wallet and white-space opportunity into the KAP growth thesis (W3427), build the pursuit plan (links to W3436), and track share-growth over time; report to the QBR (W3430)

fields.Participants: Account Manager, Pricing (links to VS-01.2/VS-57), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Finance (links to VS-101.3/VS-68), Customer procurement
fields.Trigger: KAP/JBP (W3427); contract renewal; new large opportunity

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "enterprise pricing/contract proposal" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Account Manager/Legal negotiate trading terms with customer procurement" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validate application to orders" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-551 (ensure controlled execution — Enterprise Account Growth, Contract & Executive Engagement (PA-107.2).)
- operational: margin modeling and authority limits; operational: price-book loading and compliance monitoring
Pain Points / Risks: - **Margin-erosion risk**: Over-discounting erodes margin (links to VS-101.3); mitigated by margin modeling and authority limits
- **Contract-leakage risk**: Agreed terms not applied at POS/order (links to VS-08/VS-11.2); mitigated by price-book loading and compliance monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Pricing master (links to W289); contract master (links to W402); project price book (links to VS-11.1/W163); legal (links to VS-100.3); rebate (links to VS-39)

steps.activity: Account Manager/Finance build the enterprise pricing/contract proposal: volume/mix assumptions, tiered/rebate structure (links to VS-39), price relative to SRP/trade (links to VS-01.2/VS-11), margin impact (links to VS-101.3 W3286), credit terms (links to VS-16.1/VS-68), SLAs, and duration; align to authority matrix (links to VS-36)

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / CFO
steps.activity: Account Manager/Legal negotiate trading terms with customer procurement: price/discount/rebate, volume commitment/take-or-pay, payment terms, exclusivity/preferred-supplier, SLA/penalty, termination, and risk allocation; execute the master agreement and price book (links to VS-100.3/W230/W402)

Finance/Master Data load the enterprise price book/contract into the ERP (links to W289 pricing master, W402 contract master, VS-11.1/VS-163 project price books), validate application to orders (links to VS-11.2/VS-08), and monitor contract compliance and margin realization (W3441)

fields.Participants: Account Manager, Category/Specialist (links to VS-01/VS-66/VS-70/VS-78), Design Services (links to VS-66), Installation (links to VS-12), Finance
fields.Trigger: White-space opportunity (W3433); complex customer need; RFP

workflows.name: Solutioning & Value-Proposition Development for Strategic Accounts

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "document the solutioning brief" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Specialist/Design build the value proposition and solution" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "Account Manager present the solution, refine based on feedback, and convert to a…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-551 (ensure controlled execution — Enterprise Account Growth, Contract & Executive Engagement (PA-107.2).)
- operational: diagnosis and refinement; operational: TCO/margin modeling
Pain Points / Risks: - **Solution-mismatch risk**: Solution doesn't fit the customer outcome; mitigated by diagnosis and refinement
- **Margin-of-solution risk**: Over-engineered solution erodes margin; mitigated by TCO/margin modeling
System Touchpoints: - Category/assortment (links to VS-01); design services (links to VS-66); installation (links to VS-12); staging (links to VS-77); financing (links to VS-38/VS-96)

steps.activity: Account Manager/Specialist diagnose the customer's need/outcome (e.g., a developer's multi-tower fit-out, a hospital's solar+generator system, a factory's MRO supply): pain points, success criteria, decision process, and Total Cost of Ownership; document the solutioning brief

Specialist/Design build the value proposition and solution: product/category mix (links to VS-01), services (links to VS-12 installation/VS-66 design/VS-70 solar/VS-78 green), logistics/staging (links to VS-77/VS-74), financing (links to VS-38/VS-96), and the quantified value (cost savings, single-source, schedule, warranty); package into a proposal

Account Manager present the solution, refine based on feedback, and convert to a contract (W3434) and project/order (links to VS-11.2/VS-66/VS-46); capture the solution IP for reuse and feed customer insight to innovation (W3440)

fields.Participants: Account Manager, Bid/Proposal (links to VS-11.2 W162/W166), Pricing, Finance, Legal, Executive Sponsor
fields.Trigger: Large opportunity/RFP; government bid (links to VS-46)

workflows.name: Strategic Project Pursuit, Bid Strategy & Win-Plan

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "Account Manager qualify the pursuit" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Account Manager/Bid build the win-plan and bid" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "update the KAP" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-551 (ensure controlled execution — Enterprise Account Growth, Contract & Executive Engagement (PA-107.2).)
- operational: qualification, stakeholder strategy, and sponsor engagement; operational: margin floor and deal-review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Bid-loss risk**: Weak win-plan/pursuit loses to competitor; mitigated by qualification, stakeholder strategy, and sponsor engagement
- **Unprofitable-win risk**: Winning at destructive margin (links to VS-101.3); mitigated by margin floor and deal-review
System Touchpoints: - Bid/quotation (links to VS-11.2 W162); pricing (links to VS-01.2); competitive intel (links to VS-57/VS-33.3); project (links to VS-11.2/VS-77)

steps.activity: Account Manager qualify the pursuit: fit/strategic value, win-probability, profitability, competition, resource/capacity, and risk (links to VS-21.2); make a bid/no-bid recommendation to the deal-review (links to VS-33.2)

Account Manager/Bid build the win-plan and bid: competitive positioning (links to VS-57/VS-33.3), pricing (links to W3434/VS-01.2), solution (W3435), project plan (links to VS-11.2/VS-77), risk mitigation, and stakeholder strategy (W3429); prepare the proposal/quotation (links to VS-11.2 W162) or government bid (links to VS-46)

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / COO
steps.activity: Executive Sponsor/Account Manager engage customer decision-makers through the evaluation, address objections, negotiate (links to W3434), and win (or capture loss lessons); transition the won deal to project execution (links to VS-11.2/VS-66/VS-77) and update the KAP (W3427)

fields.Participants: Account Manager, Customer Success, Service (links to VS-12/VS-47/VS-53), Training (links to VS-43.3)
fields.Trigger: Account onboarding (W3426); project completion; usage analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Account Manager/Customer Success monitor customer adoption and outcomes" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-issue of "Account Manager/Service drive adoption and outcome" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "update the KAP" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-551 (ensure controlled execution — Enterprise Account Growth, Contract & Executive Engagement (PA-107.2).)
- operational: success management; operational: early warning and intervention
Pain Points / Risks: - **Adoption-gap risk**: Customer under-uses the solution, eroding renewal/expansion; mitigated by success management
- **Churn-risk signal**: Low adoption/satisfaction precedes churn (links to W3446); mitigated by early warning and intervention
System Touchpoints: - CRM/CDP (links to VS-13.3); service/subscription (links to VS-47/VS-53/VS-12); satisfaction (links to VS-13.1/W65); project (links to VS-11.2/VS-66)

steps.activity: Account Manager/Customer Success monitor customer adoption and outcomes: product/service utilization (links to VS-47/VS-53/VS-12), project performance (links to VS-11.2/VS-66), satisfaction (links to VS-13.1/W65), and value-realization vs the value proposition (W3435); flag adoption gaps

Account Manager/Service drive adoption and outcome: onboarding/training (links to VS-43.3), service activation (links to VS-12/VS-47), issue resolution (links to VS-13.1/VS-90), and value-engineering; ensure the customer realizes the promised value

Account Manager identify and pursue expansion (upsell/cross-sell) based on adoption and white-space (W3433): additional categories, services, sites, recurring/service contracts (links to VS-47); execute via W3434/W3435 and update the KAP (W3427)

fields.Participants: Sponsor (C-suite/VP), Account Manager, Customer C-suite, Marketing/Events (links to VS-14)
fields.Trigger: Top-tier account; strategic milestone; relationship gap (W3429)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Account Manager plan the executive engagement" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "capture insights and commitments" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document executive engagement in CRM" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-551 (ensure controlled execution — Enterprise Account Growth, Contract & Executive Engagement (PA-107.2).)
- operational: continuity planning and multi-stakeholder coverage; operational: objective-driven engagement and follow-through
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sponsor-turnover risk**: Sponsor change severs the exec relationship; mitigated by continuity planning and multi-stakeholder coverage
- **Engagement-tokenism risk**: Engagement without substance erodes trust; mitigated by objective-driven engagement and follow-through
System Touchpoints: - CRM (links to VS-13.3); events/marketing (links to VS-14); CSAT/NPS (links to VS-13.1)

steps.activity: Sponsor/Account Manager plan the executive engagement: identify customer C-suite counterparts, map exec-to-exec relationships (W3429), set engagement objectives (relationship, strategic alignment, issue resolution), and design touchpoints (visits, events, briefings)

Sponsor execute the engagement: site/store visits, executive briefings, industry forums, BuildRight-hosted events (links to VS-14), and CSAT/NPS outreach (links to VS-13.1); capture insights and commitments

Account Manager document executive engagement in CRM (links to VS-13.3), cascade insights to the KAP (W3427) and QBR (W3430), and ensure continuity of exec relationships across sponsor changes; report engagement health to leadership

fields.Participants: Account Manager, Marketing (links to VS-14), CSR (links to VS-25/VS-135), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Customer marketing

workflows.name: Joint Marketing, CSR & Co-Marketing with Strategic Accounts

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Account Manager/Marketing identify joint-marketing/CSR opportunities" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-measure of "measurement, and compliance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-capture of "capture the customer reference/case-study for sales reuse" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-551 (ensure controlled execution — Enterprise Account Growth, Contract & Executive Engagement (PA-107.2).)
- operational: brand guidelines and review; operational: Legal agreement (links to VS-100)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Brand-misalignment risk**: Joint activity inconsistent with BuildRight brand/values; mitigated by brand guidelines and review
- **IP/ownership risk**: Unclear IP/brand-use terms; mitigated by Legal agreement (links to VS-100.3)
System Touchpoints: - Marketing/campaign (links to VS-14); CSR (links to VS-25/VS-135); IP/brand (links to VS-100.2); legal (links to VS-100.3)

steps.activity: Account Manager/Marketing identify joint-marketing/CSR opportunities: co-branded campaigns (links to VS-14.1), trade/industry events (links to VS-104.2), case-study/testimonial, sustainability/CSR partnership (links to VS-25/VS-135), and referral/reference; align to brand guidelines (links to VS-14.3/VS-100.2)

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / CMO
steps.activity: Marketing/Legal structure and execute the joint activity: agreement/IP/brand-use terms (links to VS-100.2/VS-100.3), cost-share, measurement, and compliance (links to VS-22); deliver the campaign/event/content

Account Manager/Marketing measure joint-marketing ROI and brand impact, capture the customer reference/case-study for sales reuse (links to VS-14/VS-13), and feed outcomes to the KAP (W3427) and QBR (W3430)

fields.Participants: Account Manager, Innovation/Product (links to VS-30/VS-01.1/VS-41), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Customer
fields.Trigger: Customer feedback/need; innovation cycle (links to VS-30)
fields.Volume: Top strategic accounts as innovation partners

workflows.name: Strategic Account Innovation, Feedback & Co-Creation Loop

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Account Manager capture structured customer feedback/needs" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-create of "create with select strategic accounts" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "Account Manager close the loop" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-551 (ensure controlled execution — Enterprise Account Growth, Contract & Executive Engagement (PA-107.2).)
- operational: routing and loop-closure; operational: scoped pilots and expectation management
Pain Points / Risks: - **Feedback-black-hole risk**: Customer input not actioned erodes trust; mitigated by routing and loop-closure
- **Pilot risk**: Pilot failure harms the relationship; mitigated by scoped pilots and expectation management
System Touchpoints: - Innovation (links to VS-30); NPI/private label (links to VS-01.1/VS-41); CRM/feedback (links to VS-13.1/VS-13.3)

steps.activity: Account Manager capture structured customer feedback/needs (product gaps, service improvements, innovation ideas) from the QBR (W3430), success management (W3437), and CX (links to VS-13.1/W87); route to Product/Innovation (links to VS-30/VS-01.1) and Private Label (links to VS-41)

Innovation/Merchandising co-create with select strategic accounts: pilot new products/services (links to VS-01.1 NPI, VS-41 private label, VS-30.1 PoC), test in the customer context, and refine; offer early-access/partnership benefits

Account Manager close the loop: communicate outcome back to the customer, credit co-creation, and roll out the validated innovation; capture the win in case-studies (W3439) and the KAP (W3427); measure innovation contribution to account growth
